parameters.name: AutoSnapshotPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.

parameters.name: FileSystemType
parameters.description:
The type of the file system.

Valid value: extreme, which indicates Extreme File Storage NAS (NAS) file systems.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas describe-auto-snapshot-policies --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-extreme-233e60000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --file-system-type extreme --region cn-hangzhou
